items.question: How long does QR ordering setup take?
items.answer: Average 2-3 hours. You just need to add menu, create tables and QR codes. We provide detailed guides and video tutorials.

items.question: Are there payment transaction fees?
items.answer: Gateway fees are set by payment partners (VNPay, MoMo, ZaloPay), typically 1-3%. Qrenso charges no additional fees.

items.question: What devices does it run on?
items.answer: Qrenso is a web app, runs on any device with a browser: laptop, tablet, phone. KDS should use tablet or large screen.

items.question: Does it support multiple branches?
items.answer: Yes. Pro plan supports up to 3 branches, Enterprise is unlimited. Each branch has its own dashboard.

items.question: How to import menu quickly?
items.answer: You can import from Excel file using our template. Or enter manually quickly through simple forms.

items.question: Is data secure?
items.answer: Data is encrypted and automatically backed up daily. We comply with international security standard ISO 27001.

items.question: Is there support when issues occur?
items.answer: Starter has email support, Pro has 24/7 chat/phone support. Enterprise has dedicated account manager.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. No long-term commitment. You can cancel anytime, data is kept for 30 days for export.
